**Does this fit the project's scope?**
mnemos deliberately keeps features narrow and fully implemented rather than
broad and half-built (see "What's intentionally out of scope" in the
README). If this is a new `StorageBackend`, `LLMClient`, or memory type,
say how it fits the existing pattern (e.g. `src/mnemos/storage/base.py`'s
interface) rather than adding a one-off special case.
